2.15.5 Subreport.CustomProperties
The Subreport.CustomProperties element specifies custom information for a subreport that will be
made available to a report rendering component. This element is optional. This element is of type
CustomProperties.
Following is the parent element of the Subreport.CustomProperties element.
Parent elements
Subreport
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Subreport.CustomProperties element.
 <xsd:element name="CustomProperties" type="CustomPropertiesType" minOccurs="0"/>
In RDL 2003/10, the equivalent element of Subreport.CustomProperties is Subreport.Custom,
which is of type Custom.
